summary: Sister of Friedrich Mayer, born in Munzingen in 1833 and dead there at twenty-four; John's 4th-great-aunt.
bio: Carolina Mayer was born in 1833 at Munzingen in Baden, a sister of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Friedrich Mayer, which makes her John's 4th-great-aunt. She died at Munzingen on 21 May 1857, aged about twenty-four. Hers was one of several family events of that year, which also saw the death of Johann Baptist Alois Mayer and the marriage of her sister.
